payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a realistic, textured interface with 3D depth, real-world metaphors (leather, wood, metal), complex gradients (8-12 stops), realistic shadows, grain/texture overlays, tactile press animations. Perfect for premium/luxury products.
payload.best_for: Legacy apps, gaming, immersive storytelling, premium products, luxury, realistic simulations, education
payload.css_technical_keywords: background: complex gradient (8-12 stops), box-shadow: realistic multi-layer, background-image: texture overlay (noise, grain), filter: drop-shadow, transform: scale on press (300-500ms)
payload.do_not_use_for: Modern enterprise, critical accessibility, low-performance, web (use Flat/Modern)
payload.effects_and_animation: Realistic shadows (layers), depth (perspective), texture details (noise, grain), realistic animations (300-500ms)
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Realistic textures applied, ☐ Complex gradients 8-12 stops, ☐ Multi-layer shadows, ☐ Texture overlays present, ☐ Tactile animations smooth, ☐ Depth effect pronounced
payload.keywords: Realistic, texture, depth, 3D appearance, real-world metaphors, shadows, gradients, tactile, detailed, material
payload.primary_colors: Rich realistic: wood, leather, metal colors, detailed gradients (8-12 stops), metallic effects
payload.secondary_colors: Realistic lighting gradients, shadow variations (30-50% darker), texture overlays, material colors
